info.title: Keyfactor API Reference and Utility
info.description:
This page provides a utility through which the Keyfactor API endpoints can be called and results returned. It is intended to be used primarily for validation, testing and workflow development. It also serves secondarily as documentation for the API.

If you would like to view documentation containing details on the Keyfactor API and endpoints, please refer to the Web API section of the Keyfactor Command documentation.

post.summary: Performs a PFX Enrollment based upon the provided request
post.description: ### IMPORTANT: - The 'RenewalCertificateId' field in the request should be set to null if the certificate is not being renewed as part of the enrollment. A value of 0 will produce an error. ### Subject Alternative Name Flags ### | Value | Description | |--------------------|---------------------------| | other | OtherName | | rfc822 | RFC822Name | | dns | DNSName | | x400 | X400Address | | directory | DirectoryName | | ediparty | EdipartyName | | uri | UniformResourceIdentifier | | ip | IPAddress | | ip4 | IPv4Address | | ip6 | IPv6Address | | registeredid | RegisteredId | | ms_ntprincipalname | MS_NTPrincipalName | | ms_ntdsreplication | MS_NTDSReplication |

Permissions.description: Permissions granted to the account represented by the audit reponse on the specified certifcate.

Keyfactor.Web.KeyfactorApi.Models.Certif.description:
Represents an account with a list of permission granted to it on a given certificate by either a role or collection.
Used for the V2 endpoint.

GrantedBy.description: A list of roles or collections that grant the given permission

Keyfactor.Web.KeyfactorApi.Models.Certif.description: Represents a permission granted to an account for a certificate

ClaimType.description: The claim type of the identity.

ClaimValue.description: The claim value of the identity.

Stores.description: A list of certificate stores a successfully issued PKCS12 should be installed into.

CustomFriendlyName.description: The Friendly name of the issued certificate

Password.description: The custom password for the resulting Private key

IncludeChain.description: An option to include the certificate chain in the response

IncludeSubjectHeader.description: An option to remove the subject header comment in pem file

RenewalCertificateId.description: An optional Id of a certificate being renewed

CertificateAuthority.description: The Certifcate Authority configuration in the format hostname\logicalname

Metadata.description: The metadata to be assigned to the certificate after issuance

AdditionalEnrollmentFields.description: Any Additional Enrollment Fields to be included in the request

Timestamp.description: A timestamp to help ensure a legitimate request

SANs.description: Any Subject Alternative Names to be included in the request

InstallIntoExistingCertificateStores.description: Allows the new certificate to be installed into all certificate stores the renewed certificate is currently installed into.

JobTime.description: The time any management jobs should be scheduled.

ChainOrder.description: The order of the certificates in the certificate chain

Curve.description: The curve being used that will be sent in when the Key Algorithm is of type ECC

AlternativeKeyType.description: Alternative Certificate key type [ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87]

AlternativeKeyLength.description: Size of the alternative certificate key.

MicrosoftTargetCSP.description: Optionally pass a microsoft cryptographic service provider to the generated certificate

OwnerRoleId.description: Id or name of the security role that will have ownership of the generated certificate

EnrollmentPatternId.description: Id of pattern for the enrollment

FileExtension.description: The file extension that the downloaded certificate will have

Name.description: The name of the security role to create

Description.description: The description to be used on the created security role

EmailAddress.description: The email address to be used on the created security role

PermissionSetId.description: The Id of the permission set this role is in.

Permissions.description: The permissions to include in the role. These must be supplied in the format of access control strings such as "/security/modify/".

Claims.description: The claim definitions to assign to the created role

Id.description: The Keyfactor identifier of the role to update

Name.description: The new name of the security role

Description.description: The new description to be used for the security role

EmailAddress.description: The new email address to be used for the security role

Permissions.description: The complete list of permissions to include in the role. These must be supplied in the format of access control strings such as "/security/modify/".

Claims.description: The complete list of claim definitions to assign to the role

Value.description: The value to compare to. This value will be compared to a true value.

Keyfactor.Web.KeyfactorApi.Models.Workfl.description: Information about the configuration of a workflow condition.

Roles.description: The information for the roles that are allowed to send this signal.

RoleTokens.description: The role tokens that are allowed to send the signal (resolved on run-time of the specific step).

Keys.description: The Keys to set on the existing workflow definition.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization Bearer Token (Prefixing with "Bearer" is not required).
